items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This particular band, I remember the drummer, Jimmy Griffin... And myself. So it was basically just a quartet.

ctx.x: How large of an ensemble was it?

It was maybe a quintet. Mel Melvin never played. He had orchestras, but scattered around different places. This particular band, I remember the drummer, Jimmy Griffin. I remember the bass player. His name was Winston. There was a saxophone player – well, Bill. And myself. So it was basically just a quartet.
